Select molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds in document CHEMBL5291721. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to include SMILES. Filter by doc_chembl_id CHEMBL5291721. Return all rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
